description: Deal management and CRM platform tailored for financial services, private equity, and professional services.
auth_notes: Authentication is performed using API keys or authorization tokens via request headers.
credential_notes: Requires an existing enterprise DealCloud subscription/workspace and administrative configuration to issue API credentials.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering core schema, entry types, fields, data rows/cells, user management, files, backups, and relationship intelligence.
mcp_notes: The official documentation includes a dedicated MCP section covering setup, AI clients, authentication, and available tools.
rationale: DealCloud offers an extensive documented REST API and official MCP support, but requires an enterprise subscription and paid workspace to obtain credentials.

evidence.note: Official documentation overview showing API surface, authentication, SDKs, and MCP integration.
